usedFor: SimpleCert holds certificate recipients and MSG91 sends mail from templates, so “New Recipient Added” can run “Send a Mail”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Recipient Added” in SimpleCert, then “Send a Mail” in MSG91
bestTemplate.why: Each new recipient gets a templated mail sent through your MSG91 account.

watchOut: A mail to someone outside your business waits in Needs you for approval before “Send a Mail” goes out.
